summary: 한국에서는 2011년 9월과 2018년 5월 어청도 등에서 몇 차례만 기록된 길잃은새이다. 러시아 서부에서 시베리아 서남부, 카자흐스탄 북부, 몽골 서북부에 걸쳐 번식하고 인도에서 겨울을 난다. 물가의 덤불이나 메마른 초원의 관목 사이를 낮게 오가며 곤충을 잡아먹는다.

art.subject: Booted Warbler (Iduna caligata), adult (sexes alike) in autumn: upperparts plain pale greyish-brown with a sandy tinge; a short whitish supercilium reaching a little behind the eye, often with a faint darker line above its front part; thin dusky eye-stripe; underparts whitish with a buff wash on the breast sides and flanks; wings plain brown with pale edges to the tertials; tail plain brown, the outer feathers edged whitish; short fine bill, dark above, the lower mandible pale with a dusky tip; dark eye; pale pinkish-grey legs.
art.pose: perched in a low shrub, side view
art.scene: low shrubs and weedy field edge on a Korean offshore island during autumn migration in September; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in autumn, side view perched in a low shrub: small rounded crestless head, clear whitish supercilium ending behind the eye, dark loral line, short fine bill with a pale lower mandible and dark tip, plain greyish-brown upperparts, short primary projection, whitish underparts with a buff tinge on the breast sides and flanks

adult, perched, rear three-quarter view with head and body facing the same way: plain greyish-brown back, rump and wings without wing bars, rather short square-ended tail with white sides, whitish supercilium
art.build: A small, plain warbler, smaller than a sparrow, with a rounded head and a rather short, square-ended tail, looking between a leaf warbler and a reed warbler in shape. No crest; the crown is smoothly rounded. Bill short and fine, much shorter than the head. Legs medium, pale pinkish-grey. Short primary projection; the wingtips reach only a short way past the tail base. Moves actively through low bushes, gleaning insects from the leaves.
avoid: Do not paint a rufous rump or warm brown upperparts (Paddyfield Warbler).
Do not paint a long reed-warbler bill or a large body.
Do not add wing-bars or a crown stripe.
Do not paint yellow or green tones; the plumage is greyish-brown and whitish.
